name: THE MEN GOING OUT
note: Doc 10: 'Men walking out with tools over their shoulders... They are talking.' The top row of room-22 operation 3's sheet: up the road from the near edge to the diggings, off the frame at both ends. A loop walker (errata 95 E; Tyler, 2026-11-05: 'Walk the road'): drawn walking its path, then off the frame between walks. Examined through the hotspot of the same name.
barksNote: A crowd on the road; their talk is doc 10's LISTEN lines.

loop.note: Heights per point: the road climbs out of the walk band into the distance (errata 95 E).
loop.strideNote: WALK-C (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "The miners are awful"): the crowd was four men stepping in unison through four frames. Now four men drawn alone, each a six-frame walk posed on Thad's (cast-unify 47, 48), the crowd composed from them by tools/art/walk-c.py: one behind another, each nearer the camera, each on his own step (phases 0, 3, 1, 4). Stride measured from the four men's own frames (R5f), calibrated on Thad's: 0.777. The crowd walking back is the same men, mirrored (doc 10: 'The same men... Same tools.').
loop.paceNote: Tyler, 2026-11-06: "The miners are awful." At a fixed 55 px/s they crawled at an eighth of their height a second near the camera (440 px tall) and raced at one and a half heights a second far up the road (36 px). Now half their own height a second at every point of the road, Deke's pace, which Tyler passed; `speed` is no longer read.
